basic_profile.bio: I'm a culinary enthusiast exploring the world of healthy eating from Ahmedabad, India. I'm particularly fascinated by alternative ingredients like konjac noodles. I work as a graphic designer and enjoy experimenting with different cuisines in my spare time. Typically online in the evenings after work. Currently single and focusing on self-improvement and learning new skills.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge predominantly stems from self-teaching through online resources and communities. I'm passionate about design and cooking, often blending my artistic skills with culinary creativity. My interest in volume eating is quite new, sparked by health documentaries and online forums.
